scripts.dev: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && uv --directory backend sync
